QUOTE: The allow list only skips the prompt. It doesn't grant anything by itself beyond skipping the callback.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the allow list only suppresses the approval prompt and doesn't grant execution. It also shows the allow list consulted only via `check_approval` at `tool_executor.cpp:161` (via `ServerManager::is_explicitly_allowed`, a different file from `permission_manager.cpp`).
